{{Top|leg}}
A '''back-blast impeller''' was part of the [[Gurian]] [[S87 "perpetual charge" power plant dynamo]]. The impellers recycled energy from the air cushion generated by [[Kasmin]] three-cycle [[turbopump]]s on the [[Swift Assault 5]] to increase energy efficiency.
